name: Contemporary Blue Two-Seater Sofa
description: A contemporary two-seater sofa upholstered in bright blue faux leather or vinyl, featuring a grid-tufted seat and backrest. The sofa has open-frame armrests with upholstered top pads, supported by cylindrical polished metal posts. It stands on four slender, cylindrical polished metal legs.

name: Modern Modular Two-Tone Sectional Sofa with Channel Tufting
description: A modern modular sectional sofa featuring a two-tone upholstery design. The seating surfaces and backrests are upholstered in a light beige, textured fabric, while the integrated armrests and lower frame components are covered in a contrasting dark brown faux leather. The backrests exhibit subtle horizontal channel tufting, and the sofa is supported by sleek, dark-finished metal legs.

name: Contemporary Metal Frame Loveseat
description: A contemporary two-seater loveseat featuring a minimalist design with a slim, light-colored metal frame and thick, comfortable upholstered cushions. The frame forms the legs, base, and integrated armrests. The seating includes a single seat cushion, two back cushions, and two smaller accent pillows, all upholstered in a light beige or off-white fabric.

name: Woven Leather Sofa
description: A contemporary low-profile sofa featuring a distinctive dark brown woven leather upholstery. The design is minimalist with integrated arms and backrest, creating a seamless and rectilinear form.

name: Contemporary Curvilinear Velvet Sofa
description: A contemporary two-seater sofa upholstered in dark purple velvet, featuring a distinctive undulating backrest and integrated, rounded armrests. The design has a low-profile, seamless appearance.

name: Contemporary Light Grey Fabric Loveseat
description: A contemporary two-seater sofa, commonly known as a loveseat, upholstered in a light grey textured fabric. It features clean, minimalist lines with gently curved armrests and rests on slim, tapered legs, likely made of metal or dark wood.

name: Modern Modular Dark Gray Leather Sofa with Tufted Backrest
description: A contemporary modular sofa upholstered in dark gray leather, featuring a subtly tufted backrest and wide, rounded track arms. The sofa comprises two distinct sections, supported by a low-profile base with dark, minimalist feet. Two matching loose throw pillows are included.

name: U-shaped Modular Boucle Sectional Sofa
description: A large, U-shaped sectional sofa upholstered in a cream-colored boucle fabric. It features a modular design with multiple sections, including chaise ends on both sides and a series of back cushions. The sofa has a low profile with wide, comfortable seating and rounded, integrated armrests.

name: Modern Modular Sectional Sofa Set with Integrated Tables and Ottomans
description: A contemporary modular sectional sofa set featuring a light beige textured upholstery, low profile design, and soft, rounded edges. The set includes a multi-piece sectional sofa, two integrated dark brown tabletops, and two matching upholstered ottomans, all resting on a subtle, raised base.

name: Mid-Century Modern Wooden Frame Two-Seater Sofa
description: A mid-century modern style two-seater sofa featuring an exposed dark wooden frame with clean lines. It has light beige upholstery on the back and seat cushions, which are rectangular and well-defined. The sofa includes open wooden armrests and tapers down to four solid wooden legs, showcasing a minimalist and functional design.

name: Traditional Tan Leather Two-Seater Sofa
description: A traditional two-seater loveseat upholstered in supple tan leather, featuring plush, overstuffed seat and back cushions, and gently rolled arms. The design emphasizes comfort and a classic aesthetic.

name: Contemporary Dark Green Leather Three-Seater Sofa
description: A contemporary three-seater sofa upholstered in dark green leather, featuring three plump seat cushions and three matching back cushions. It has rounded, rolled armrests and a base that rests on low, dark block feet.

name: Curved Contemporary Loveseat
description: A contemporary loveseat featuring a sleek, fully upholstered design with gracefully curved arms and an integrated backrest. It is finished in a light beige, textured fabric and comes with two matching throw pillows and one accent pillow with a geometric pattern. The loveseat has a compact, modern silhouette with a subtle, low profile and a clean, streamlined base.

name: Modern Three-Seater Fabric Sofa
description: A contemporary three-seater sofa upholstered in a teal blue fabric. It features a streamlined silhouette with square track arms and three individual seat cushions. Three matching back cushions provide support, and the entire piece is elevated by subtle, dark block feet.

name: Contemporary Three-Seater Fabric Sofa
description: A contemporary three-seater sofa upholstered in a light beige, finely woven fabric. It features wide, squared track arms, two large seat cushions, and two large back cushions. The sofa rests on small, dark, recessed block feet. It is accessorized with four throw pillows, two solid beige and two with a brown, grey, and white wavy pattern.

name: Contemporary Curved Two-Seater Sofa
description: A contemporary two-seater sofa featuring a distinctive curved, armless design. The seating and backrest are upholstered in smooth, olive-green material, likely leather or faux leather, with prominent stitching. The base of the sofa contrasts with a dark green, intricately textured or woven material.

name: Two-seater Cane Webbing Sofa with Wood Frame
description: A modern two-seater sofa featuring a light-toned wooden frame with rounded edges, cane webbing back and side panels, and comfortable, removable white fabric seat and back cushions. The sofa stands on slender, tapered wooden legs.

name: Contemporary Bouclé Two-Seater Sofa
description: A contemporary two-seater sofa upholstered in a cream-colored bouclé fabric. It features a minimalist design with wide, rounded track arms and a low-profile silhouette. The sofa has two distinct seat cushions and two matching back cushions, providing a clean, inviting look.

name: Modern Black Leatherette Loveseat with Sled Base
description: A modern two-seater loveseat featuring a sleek black leatherette upholstery, square arms, and loose back cushions. The entire piece is supported by a minimalist chrome or polished metal sled base, giving it a contemporary and light aesthetic. The design is clean-lined and functional.

name: Modern Two-Seater Fabric Sofa with Tapered Legs
description: A modern two-seater sofa upholstered in a light beige fabric, featuring a clean, minimalist design with subtly rolled armrests and two separate seat and back cushions. The sofa is supported by four short, tapered wooden legs, which add a touch of warmth and elegance to its contemporary aesthetic. The overall appearance suggests comfort and versatility, suitable for various interior styles.

name: Contemporary Light Gray Fabric Sofa with Rounded Arms and Wooden Accents
description: A contemporary three-seater sofa upholstered in light gray fabric, featuring gently rounded armrests and a high backrest. The sofa includes two dark blue throw pillows and is accented with light-toned wooden elements integrated into the side panels, which also serve as decorative feet.

name: Modular Serpentine Sectional Sofa
description: A large, contemporary modular sectional sofa featuring a serpentine or S-shaped configuration. It is upholstered in a smooth, light-colored material, likely faux leather, with plush, rounded cushions and low-profile backrests. The modular components allow for flexible arrangement, culminating in a chaise-like end on one side. Two accent pillows, one teal and one light grey, are placed on the sofa.

name: Rococo Gilded Tufted Loveseat
description: A luxurious two-seater sofa, commonly known as a loveseat, featuring an elaborately carved and gilded wooden frame with plush white button-tufted upholstery. The frame exhibits intricate scrollwork and floral motifs characteristic of Rococo design, finished in a bright gold. The seat cushions are smooth white, offering a contrast to the textured, tufted backrest. The piece is accompanied by two matching white throw pillows, completing its opulent aesthetic.

name: Contemporary Curved Two-Seater Sofa with Fluted Arms
description: A contemporary two-seater sofa featuring a distinctive curved silhouette. It is upholstered in a light-colored, finely textured fabric, and accented with bronze-toned metal trim along its base and armrests. The exterior of the armrests features elegant vertical fluting, adding to its sophisticated design. The sofa has two segmented seat cushions and two matching back cushions, creating a refined and comfortable seating option.

name: Contemporary L-shaped Sectional Sofa with Matching Ottoman
description: A contemporary L-shaped sectional sofa with an accompanying square ottoman, upholstered in a light beige or off-white fabric. The sofa features a low-profile design with an exposed wooden frame that forms the base and supports the tapered legs. The L-shape is formed by a long sofa section and a chaise lounge extension, providing ample seating. Both the sofa and ottoman are equipped with soft, plush cushions for comfort, including several back cushions and smaller throw pillows. The design emphasizes clean lines and a minimalist aesthetic.

name: Modular Sectional Sofa with Rounded Chaise
description: A contemporary modular sectional sofa upholstered in light gray fabric, featuring a distinctive rounded chaise lounge component. The sofa is composed of at least two sections: a straight, armless section with a low back and integrated armrests, and a large, curved chaise lounge module. It includes multiple loose back cushions and several smaller throw pillows, all covered in the same textured fabric. The design is minimalist with clean lines and soft edges.

name: Contemporary L-Shaped Sectional Sofa with Chaise and Matching Ottoman
description: An L-shaped sectional sofa featuring light beige fabric upholstery, an exposed dark brown wooden frame, and tapered legs. The sofa includes multiple loose back cushions and seat cushions, with an integrated chaise lounge on the right side. Several decorative accent pillows in shades of orange and patterned cream are placed on the sofa. An accompanying rectangular ottoman, also upholstered in light beige fabric with matching tapered wooden legs, is positioned in front of the sectional.

name: Mid-Century Modern Velvet Two-Seater Sofa
description: A two-seater sofa featuring dark, plush velvet upholstery and a prominent exposed wooden frame. The design includes a gently curved backrest and armrests, with two loose seat cushions and two loose back cushions. The sofa is supported by sturdy, integrated wooden legs.

name: Pink Upholstered Daybed with Trundle Drawer
description: An upholstered daybed in a light pink color, featuring a patterned fabric on the armrests and base, with a hidden trundle drawer underneath.

name: Contemporary Two-Seater Fabric and Faux Leather Sofa
description: A contemporary two-seater sofa featuring light beige fabric upholstery for the main body, seat, and back cushions. The armrests and the outer sides of the back cushions are accented with dark brown faux leather. The sofa is supported by four slender, angled black metal legs, providing a modern aesthetic.

name: Contemporary Modular Sectional Sofa with Integrated Chaise
description: A contemporary modular sectional sofa composed of multiple upholstered blocks. It features two primary seating sections in a light gray fabric, each with a seat cushion and two back cushions. An armrest is present on one end of the light gray section. A distinct, rectangular block upholstered in a contrasting tan material is integrated on the left side, functioning as a chaise extension or ottoman. The design emphasizes clean lines and a low profile, characteristic of modern modular furniture.

name: Modern Green Upholstered Two-Seater Sofa with Wire Base
description: A contemporary two-seater sofa or loveseat featuring a sage green upholstered finish and a minimalist black wire frame base. It includes two matching throw pillows.

name: Modular Corduroy Sofa Bed
description: A contemporary modular sofa bed featuring olive green corduroy upholstery, a stacked cushion base, and a unique tubular chrome metal armrest on one side.

name: Modular L-Shaped Corduroy Sectional Sofa
description: A dark gray corduroy modular L-shaped sectional sofa with soft, plump cushions and a low profile.

name: Teak Wood Outdoor Three-Seater Sofa
description: A three-seater outdoor sofa featuring a natural teak wood frame and white upholstered cushions. The design includes a slatted backrest and integrated armrests.

name: Contemporary Upholstered Curved Modular Sectional Sofa with Integrated Ottoman
description: A light grey upholstered modular sectional sofa featuring a distinct curved design, composed of multiple units including an integrated ottoman or chaise section. The sofa is adorned with several decorative cushions in varying shades of brown, grey, and patterned fabric.

name: Contemporary L-shaped Sectional Sofa with Track Arms
description: An L-shaped sectional sofa in a neutral beige fabric with clean lines and soft cushioning, suitable for modern living spaces.

name: Contemporary Modular Upholstered Sofa
description: A contemporary modular sofa system configured as a three-seater unit, featuring soft, rounded edges and upholstered in a dark charcoal gray textured fabric.

name: Transitional Wood-Framed Sectional Sofa with Left-Hand Chaise
description: A transitional style sectional sofa featuring a left-hand facing chaise lounge, upholstered in light cream fabric, with a visible dark wood frame and turned legs.

name: Modern Walnut Daybed with Fabric Bolsters
description: A modern daybed featuring a minimalist design with a dark walnut-stained wood base that gives a floating appearance. It is topped with a thick, rectangular cushion upholstered in a light beige, textured fabric. Two matching cylindrical bolster pillows are positioned at each end of the cushion. The overall aesthetic is clean, contemporary, and functional for lounging.

name: Upholstered Daybed with Integrated Corner Backrest
description: A modern upholstered daybed featuring an integrated L-shaped backrest and side rail, covered in a textured teal fabric.

name: Modern Gray Fabric Modular Sectional Sofa with Chaise
description: A modern L-shaped sectional sofa upholstered in light gray fabric, consisting of a three-seater section and an integrated chaise lounge or large ottoman. It features clean lines, broad track arms, and separate seat and back cushions.

name: Scandinavian Light Wood Frame Three-Seater Sofa
description: A minimalist three-seater sofa featuring an exposed light-toned wooden frame and plush white cushions. The design incorporates clean lines and a contemporary aesthetic, characteristic of Scandinavian modern furniture. The back cushions are lightly tufted with a single button, and the armrests are integrated into the continuous wooden frame, which extends down to form tapered, rounded legs.

name: Modern Grey Upholstered Three-Seater Sofa with Adjustable Headrests
description: A modern three-seater sofa upholstered in a light grey fabric, featuring plush, segmented cushions and distinctive adjustable headrests. The design includes gently rolled armrests and two matching throw pillows, with a grey patterned throw blanket draped over one arm. The sofa rests on subtle wooden leg accents visible at the ends.

name: Contemporary Channel-Tufted Sofa
description: A contemporary sofa featuring distinct channel-tufted or ribbed upholstery in a light grey textured fabric. The sofa has a streamlined, armless design with a low profile, offering a modern aesthetic. It includes two matching throw pillows.

name: Contemporary Fabric Track Arm Sofa
description: A contemporary three-seater sofa upholstered in a light beige textured fabric. It features clean lines, track arms, and two large seat cushions. The backrest is composed of two loose cushions, complemented by three decorative throw pillows—two in olive green and one in a light tan hue. The sofa rests on small, recessed wooden block feet.

name: Modern Asymmetrical Upholstered Daybed
description: A modern, asymmetrical daybed featuring a curvilinear form factor, upholstered in a light beige fabric. It has integrated low-profile backrests that follow its organic shape, and is accessorized with several decorative throw pillows in varying patterns and solid colors.

name: Modern Oriental Daybed with Integrated Table
description: A long, low-profile daybed with a dark wooden frame, featuring two upholstered sections with cream-colored cushions and bolster pillows, separated by a central black integrated table. The backrest has a decorative spindled design.

name: Modern Two-Seater Sofa with Integrated Cushions
description: A modern two-seater sofa featuring light blue textile upholstery, integrated seat and back cushions, and rounded armrests. The sofa sits on a dark, minimalist base frame, suggesting a contemporary or minimalist aesthetic.

name: Contemporary Two-Seater Sofa with Sculpted Wood Arms
description: A contemporary two-seater sofa featuring a rounded, plump silhouette upholstered in a textured sage green bouclé fabric. The sofa includes distinctive dark, sculpted wooden panels on the exterior of its arms, which extend downwards to form part of the base.

name: Modernist Tubular Metal Frame Two-Seater Sofa with Corduroy Upholstery
description: A two-seater sofa featuring a minimalist tubular metal frame, supporting thick, comfortable cushions upholstered in brown corduroy fabric. The design is clean and contemporary, with the frame forming the arms and backrest.

name: Contemporary Deep Green Two-Seater Sofa with Rounded Arms
description: A two-seater sofa upholstered in a deep green textured fabric. It features a soft, rounded silhouette with integrated, plump armrests that gently curve inwards. The seat base is distinguished by a subtle buttonless tufting pattern, creating a grid-like visual texture. Two large, loose rectangular back cushions are placed against the backrest. The sofa is supported by short, dark, cylindrical feet, giving it a low-profile stance.

name: L-shaped Sectional Sofa with Chaise
description: A large, L-shaped sectional sofa featuring a right-hand facing chaise lounge. It is upholstered in a light, neutral-toned fabric and includes several loose back cushions. Multiple throw pillows in shades of green and a decorative pattern provide accent. The sofa is designed with clean lines, square track arms, and is supported by short, tapered wooden legs.

name: Contemporary Ribbed Upholstery Lounge Sofa
description: A contemporary low-profile lounge sofa featuring a distinct ribbed upholstery in an earthy brown hue. The sofa has a segmented backrest and seat cushions, with a particularly elongated, armless section on the right side designed for lounging. It rests on a sculptural, flared wooden base that provides a sturdy yet elegant foundation, lifting the body of the sofa off the floor. The overall aesthetic is minimalist, organic, and comfortable, suitable for modern living spaces.

name: Minimalist Wooden Daybed with Upholstered Bolsters
description: A minimalist daybed featuring a light-toned wooden frame and two-tone fabric upholstery. It has a long, rectangular main cushion in a light brown hue, complemented by two integrated bolster cushions at either end in a lighter beige fabric. The frame has rounded edges and extends into four sturdy legs.

name: Modern Upholstered Two-Seater Sofa with Track Arms and Bolster Pillows
description: A contemporary two-seater sofa featuring a clean-lined design with track arms and upholstered in a light beige fabric. It includes loose seat cushions, large back cushions, two square throw pillows, and two cylindrical bolster pillows. The sofa is supported by slender, dark metal legs.

name: Organic Modern Curved Sectional Sofa with Chaise
description: A large, light gray curved sectional sofa with a rounded chaise end, featuring soft, organic lines and plush back cushions, accented with furry decorative pillows.

name: Contemporary Channel-Tufted Fabric Loveseat
description: A contemporary loveseat featuring a beige fabric upholstery with distinctive channel and square tufting. The design is blocky and minimalist, with integrated wide, square armrests.

name: Contemporary Plush Two-Seater Sofa
description: A front view of a rust-colored upholstered two-seater loveseat with a plush, modern design. It features soft, rounded armrests and backrests, with subtle button tufting on the back cushions and a textured fabric finish.

name: Contemporary L-Shaped Rolled Arm Sectional Sofa
description: An L-shaped sectional sofa with a light cream or off-white fabric upholstery. It features rolled arms, multiple loose seat cushions, and loose back cushions, along with several accent pillows. The sofa rests on short, dark, tapered block feet.

name: Contemporary Three-Seater Velvet Sofa with Wavy Back
description: A contemporary three-seater sofa upholstered in dark blue velvet, featuring a distinctive wavy backrest and integrated, curvaceous armrests. The upholstery appears plush and slightly draped, contributing to a relaxed yet elegant aesthetic. The sofa sits low, presenting a substantial and inviting form.

name: Three-seater gray fabric sofa with tufted back cushions
description: A modern three-seater sofa upholstered in light gray fabric, featuring grid-tufted back cushions, plain seat cushions, straight arms, and subtle tapered wooden legs.

name: Contemporary Upholstered Sofa with Wood Legs
description: A long, modern, upholstered sofa in a light cream or off-white fabric, featuring deep seats, plump back cushions, and wide, gently sloping armrests. It is supported by visible, curved wooden legs. Two decorative throw pillows, one brown and one black-and-white patterned, are also present.

name: Contemporary Curved Boucle Sofa
description: A contemporary curved sofa upholstered in a creamy white boucle fabric, featuring a low-profile design and soft, organic lines. The sofa appears to be composed of two distinct segments, suggesting a modular construction that forms a gentle curve. It lacks visible legs, giving it a floor-level or very low-set appearance, contributing to its modern aesthetic.

name: Terracotta Upholstered Convertible Floor Sofa Bed
description: A terracotta-colored upholstered convertible floor sofa bed. It features a low-profile design with multiple layers of plush cushions, suggesting it can transform from a sofa into a flat sleeping surface. The fabric has a textured, soft appearance.

name: Contemporary Two-Seater Leather Sofa
description: A contemporary two-seater sofa, or loveseat, upholstered in smooth, light taupe-colored leather. It features clean lines, square track arms, two plush back cushions, and two deep seat cushions, all accented with subtle piping. The sofa is elevated on slender, angled legs with a polished brass finish, contributing to its modern aesthetic.

name: Three-Seater Track Arm Sofa
description: A modern three-seater sofa featuring a clean, minimalist design. It has straight track arms, three loose seat cushions, and three loose back cushions. The sofa is upholstered in a light beige textured fabric and supported by short, tapered dark wood legs.

name: Contemporary Grey Fabric Two-Seater Sofa with Rolled Arms and Turned Wood Bun Feet
description: A contemporary two-seater sofa upholstered in a light grey woven fabric. The sofa features plush, removable seat and back cushions, gently rolled armrests, and rests on four visible turned wooden bun feet. The overall design is clean and inviting, with visible stitching detail on the cushions.

name: Modern Two-Seater Cognac Leather Sofa
description: A two-seater sofa with a modern design, upholstered in a rich cognac brown leather. It features clean lines, squared armrests, and two distinct seat cushions alongside two matching back cushions. The sofa is supported by slender, tapered black metal legs, giving it a minimalist and elevated appearance. A light-colored throw blanket is draped over one armrest.

name: Contemporary Upholstered Sofa with Curved Arms and Metal Accents
description: A contemporary three-seater sofa characterized by its low-profile design and elegant curved arms. The sofa is upholstered in a light beige or greige fabric, providing a neutral and sophisticated aesthetic. It features a dark, recessed base, possibly made of wood, accented with polished gold or brass elements at the front corners, which subtly elevate the piece. The backrest is adorned with five throw pillows, alternating in shades of light and dark brown, adding texture and comfort. The overall design emphasizes modern luxury with its clean lines and soft, inviting curves.

name: Contemporary Channel-Tufted Boucle Sofa
description: A contemporary modular sofa featuring a soft, rounded silhouette upholstered in a textured off-white boucle fabric. The design incorporates channel tufting across the seat and back, creating distinct, plush sections. The sofa has a continuous, low-profile form, with subtle curved wooden accents integrated into the lower side panels.

name: Art Deco Grey Velvet Loveseat with Burl Wood Arms
description: A two-seater loveseat featuring a distinctive Art Deco design. It has plush grey velvet upholstery for the seat and backrest, contrasted by large, curved, solid-looking burl wood armrests that seamlessly integrate with the plinth-style base. The wood exhibits a rich, dark brown color with prominent, intricate grain patterns. The overall form is elegant and substantial.

name: Convertible Corduroy Futon Loveseat with Integrated Cup Holders
description: A compact, two-seater convertible futon sofa upholstered in a light beige ribbed corduroy fabric. The design features thick, stacked cushions that form the seat and back, suggesting a foldable or reclinable mechanism. Both armrests are wide and softly padded, each housing a recessed black plastic cup holder. A silver-toned metal support frame is visible on the right side, indicating the convertible nature of the piece. The overall aesthetic is casual and functional, ideal for smaller living spaces.

name: Modern Low-Profile Fabric Loveseat
description: A modern, low-profile loveseat upholstered in a light beige, textured fabric. It features thick, square track arms, a deep seat cushion, and loose back cushions, along with two smaller accent pillows. The design is minimalist and contemporary, with no visible legs.

name: Contemporary Rounded Asymmetrical Chaise Sofa
description: A modern, low-profile, asymmetrical sofa upholstered in a terracotta-colored fabric. It features softly rounded edges and an extended chaise-like section on the right, providing ample lounging space. Two spherical accent pillows in the same fabric are placed against the left armrest. The overall design is sleek and contemporary.

name: Art Deco Inspired Curved Green Velvet Sofa
description: A large, elegant curved sofa upholstered in a rich, deep green velvet fabric. It features a distinctive segmented backrest with three separate cushions, each defined by contrasting white piping. This white piping also accents the gracefully curved arms and runs along the bottom edge of the seat cushion, adding a crisp, decorative detail. The sofa has a low-profile design and rests on a dark, recessed plinth base.

name: Organic Biomorphic Two-Seater Sofa
description: A contemporary two-seater sofa featuring a distinctive organic, biomorphic form. It has a dark, possibly molded plastic or fiberglass base that forms a fluid, undulating perimeter, contrasting with soft, irregularly shaped, light-colored upholstered cushions. The design emphasizes natural, curvilinear lines and contrasting textures.

name: Modular Corduroy Sectional Sofa
description: A contemporary modular seating unit, likely a sectional sofa, upholstered in a rich, ribbed corduroy fabric in a dark brown hue. It features three distinct cushioned segments for the seat and three corresponding backrest cushions, creating a low-profile, comfortable appearance. A brushed metal U-shaped support frame is visible on the right end, securing the cushions and providing a structural design element.

name: Modern Plum Fabric Sectional Sofa with Chaise
description: A modern L-shaped sectional sofa upholstered in a rich plum-colored fabric, featuring a chaise extension on the left side. It has a low-profile design with straight arms and back, supported by slim, black metal legs. The sofa includes loose back cushions and two contrasting orange accent pillows.

name: Outdoor Two-Seater Sofa with Metal and Wood Frame
description: A modern outdoor two-seater sofa featuring a sturdy light-colored metal frame combined with slatted natural wood accents on the armrests and backrest side panels. The seating area includes thick, comfortable cushions upholstered in a light beige, weather-resistant fabric.

name: Modern L-shaped Sectional Sofa with Wooden Base and Metal Legs
description: A modern L-shaped sectional sofa upholstered in light beige fabric, featuring an exposed wooden base trim and slender black metal legs. The sofa includes several decorative throw pillows in various patterns and a green knitted throw blanket draped over one arm.

name: Modern Fabric Sectional Sofa with Chaise and Integrated Side Table
description: A modern sectional sofa featuring a modular design with a chaise lounge extension and an integrated side table at one end. It is upholstered in a light taupe or beige textured fabric, with loose back cushions that have button tufting and additional decorative throw pillows with patterned fabric. The sofa rests on a minimalist, slender metal frame that forms U-shaped legs, giving it a light, elevated appearance.

name: Curved Modular Sectional Sofa
description: A deep maroon or burgundy modular sectional sofa featuring a distinctive curved, serpentine design. The sofa is composed of several upholstered sections that fit together to form a continuous, flowing seat. It has a low profile with integrated, gently rounded backrests and armrests, suggesting a contemporary and comfortable aesthetic. The fabric appears to be a textured, possibly bouclé or chenille material, providing a soft tactile quality. The item is presented against a plain white background, highlighting its form and color.

name: Contemporary Light Gray Sectional Sofa with Chaise
description: A contemporary light gray sectional sofa featuring a right-facing chaise lounge, three back cushions, and block-style arms and feet. The upholstery appears to be a durable woven fabric.

name: Modern Three-Seater Upholstered Sofa
description: A modern three-seater sofa upholstered in a neutral beige or taupe fabric, featuring a clean, minimalist design. It has padded track arms, three distinct seat cushions, and three plush back cushions with subtle tufting. The sofa is supported by short, tapered wooden legs, adding a touch of Scandinavian or contemporary aesthetic.

name: Modern L-Shaped Sectional Sofa with Integrated Wood Side Tables
description: A sophisticated L-shaped sectional sofa featuring a low-profile design, upholstered in a light grey fabric, and accented with dark wood integrated side tables. It includes multiple back cushions for comfort.

name: Mid-Century Modern Emerald Velvet Three-Seater Sofa with Walnut Frame
description: A stylish three-seater sofa featuring a distinctive mid-century modern design. The sofa is upholstered in a rich emerald green velvet fabric, with square tufting on the back cushions. The frame is constructed from dark walnut wood, forming gracefully curved open armrests and a base that supports individual seat cushions. The sofa stands on slender, tapered wooden legs, complementing its minimalist yet elegant aesthetic.

name: Two-Piece Modular Chaise Sofa
description: A two-piece modular chaise sofa upholstered in a light beige textured fabric. Each module features a deep, low-profile seat with a small, rectangular backrest cushion, and an additional smaller rectangular throw pillow. The design emphasizes comfort and versatility, allowing for various configurations. The sofa sits low to the ground on small, discreet black feet. The upholstery appears uniform across all surfaces, creating a cohesive and minimalist aesthetic.

name: Contemporary Upholstered Sofa with Exposed Wood Frame
description: A modern upholstered sofa featuring a light-colored, textured fabric and an exposed natural wood frame and legs. It has two broad seat cushions, two large back cushions, and two additional smaller throw pillows, creating a plush and inviting seating arrangement.

name: Contemporary Three-Seater Sofa with Exposed Walnut Base
description: A contemporary three-seater sofa featuring a clean-lined design, upholstered in a muted taupe fabric. It has an exposed dark walnut wood base with matching tapered legs. The sofa includes three separate seat cushions and three loose back cushions, along with four accent pillows in varying shades of grey and taupe.

name: Modern Curved Upholstered Loveseat
description: An upholstered loveseat featuring a contemporary design with a curved back and integrated arms. The main body and plush seat cushion are upholstered in a light, textured beige fabric, while the lower base is covered in a contrasting dark brown fabric.

name: Traditional Carved Teakwood Sofa with Linen Upholstery
description: A traditional-style three-seater sofa featuring a robust dark wood frame with intricate carved details. The sofa has a tall, slightly curved backrest frame and substantial armrests, both integrated into the wooden structure. The side panels of the armrests are adorned with elaborate, organic floral and vine carvings. The seating area consists of a base panel and a back panel, both upholstered in a plain, textured light brown fabric, likely linen or a similar blend, providing comfort against the solid wood frame. The lower front portion of the sofa features vertical wood paneling, giving it a sturdy and enclosed appearance.
